title: Navigating the Risks: A Survey of Security and Privacy Threats in LLM-Based Agents
title_zh: 驶过风险区：LLM Agent 安全与隐私威胁综述
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), accepted 2026
why_zh: 适合作为第一篇阅读：它从威胁来源、影响和 Agent 特性三个角度整理领域，能先建立完整地图，再进入单点攻击。
why_en: A strong first read: it maps the field by threat source, impact, and agent feature before the reader dives into individual attacks.
contributions_zh: 提出能覆盖跨模块、跨阶段风险的分类法。
归纳六类会改变风险暴露面的 Agent 特性。
用搜索、游戏、导航和软件开发案例连接分类与真实系统。
contributions_en: Builds a taxonomy that captures cross-module and cross-stage threats.
Distills six agent features that shape security exposure.
Connects the taxonomy to search, gaming, navigation, and software-engineering case studies.

title: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents
title_zh: Agent Security Bench：形式化并评测 LLM Agent 的攻击与防御
why_zh: 它把用户输入、工具观察、记忆和规划放进同一测试框架，适合横向理解 Agent 各模块的攻击面。
why_en: It puts user input, tool observations, memory, and planning into one framework, making cross-module comparison possible.
contributions_zh: 构建覆盖 10 个场景、10 个 Agent 和 400 多个工具的综合基准。
统一评测提示注入、记忆投毒、Plan-of-Thought 后门和混合攻击。
在多种 LLM 骨干上比较攻击、防御与正常任务表现。
contributions_en: Builds a benchmark spanning 10 scenarios, 10 agents, and more than 400 tools.
Evaluates prompt injection, memory poisoning, Plan-of-Thought backdoors, and mixed attacks in one framework.
Compares attacks, defenses, and benign task performance across multiple LLM backbones.

title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
title_zh: AgentDojo：动态评测 LLM Agent 提示注入攻击与防御
why_zh: 这是 Agent 提示注入研究中使用最广的动态环境之一，同时测攻击成功和正常任务效用，不会把“什么都拒绝”误当成安全。
why_en: A widely used dynamic environment that measures both attack success and benign utility, so blanket refusal is not mistaken for security.
contributions_zh: 提供可扩展环境，而不是只发布一组固定攻击字符串。
包含 97 个真实任务和 629 个安全测试用例。
把攻击目标、正常任务完成度和防御代价分开计量。
contributions_en: Provides an extensible environment rather than a fixed list of attack strings.
Includes 97 realistic tasks and 629 security test cases.
Separates attacker success, benign task utility, and defense cost.

title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
title_zh: AgentHarm：衡量 LLM Agent 有害行为的基准
why_zh: 它关注 Agent 是否真正通过工具完成有害多步任务，而不是只检查输出里有没有危险文字。
why_en: It asks whether agents actually complete harmful multi-step tool tasks, not merely whether their text sounds unsafe.
contributions_zh: 设计跨多类危害的多步工具调用任务。
用可执行行为评分，而不是只靠文本分类。
配套良性任务，区分“安全拒绝”和“根本不会用工具”。
contributions_en: Designs multi-step tool-use tasks across diverse harm categories.
Scores executable behavior rather than relying only on text classification.
Adds benign counterparts to separate safe refusal from lack of agent capability.

title: Not What You've Signed Up For: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
title_zh: 这不是你同意的事：用间接提示注入攻陷真实 LLM 应用
why_zh: 这是理解间接提示注入的奠基性案例研究：攻击者不直接和 Agent 对话，只需污染它会读取的网页或文档。
why_en: A foundational case study of indirect prompt injection: the attacker poisons content the agent will read instead of chatting with it directly.
contributions_zh: 明确提出并演示远程间接提示注入攻击面。
给出数据窃取、蠕虫传播和 API 操纵等影响分类。
在真实系统与合成应用上证明攻击链可行。
contributions_en: Defines and demonstrates the remote indirect-prompt-injection surface.
Taxonomizes impacts including data theft, worming, and API manipulation.
Shows practical attack chains on real and synthetic applications.

title: Prompt Injection Attack against LLM-Integrated Applications
title_zh: 针对 LLM 集成应用的提示注入攻击
why_zh: HouYi 把提示注入从零散手工技巧推进为可组合的黑盒攻击框架，并在商业应用上做了大规模实测。
why_en: HouYi turns ad-hoc prompt injection into a composable black-box attack framework and evaluates it on commercial applications.
contributions_zh: 把攻击拆成预构造提示、上下文分隔和恶意载荷三部分。
在 36 个真实应用上测试，报告 31 个可被攻击。
展示任意使用模型和窃取应用提示等实际后果。
contributions_en: Decomposes attacks into a framework prompt, context separator, and malicious payload.
Tests 36 real applications and reports 31 as vulnerable.
Demonstrates practical outcomes such as unauthorized model use and prompt theft.

title: Formalizing and Benchmarking Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses
title_zh: 提示注入攻击与防御的形式化和基准评测
why_zh: 它给提示注入一个统一定义和实验平台，适合学习如何做公平、可重复的攻防比较。
why_en: It supplies a common formalization and experiment platform for fair, reproducible comparisons of prompt-injection attacks and defenses.
contributions_zh: 建立统一的提示注入形式化框架。
系统比较 5 种攻击、10 种防御、10 个模型和 7 类任务。
公开平台，降低后续研究的复现实验成本。
contributions_en: Introduces a unified formal framework for prompt injection.
Compares 5 attacks and 10 defenses across 10 models and 7 tasks.
Releases a platform that lowers the cost of reproducible follow-up work.

title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
title_zh: InjecAgent：工具型 LLM Agent 的间接提示注入基准
why_zh: 它专门研究恶意指令藏在工具返回值里的情况，场景与当前邮件、日历、金融类 Agent 很接近。
why_en: It focuses on malicious instructions hidden in tool outputs, closely matching modern email, calendar, and finance agents.
contributions_zh: 构建 1,054 个测试用例，覆盖 17 个用户工具和 62 个攻击者工具。
把攻击目标分为直接伤害和私密数据外泄。
系统比较 30 种 LLM Agent 配置的脆弱性。
contributions_en: Builds 1,054 cases across 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools.
Separates attack goals into direct harm and private-data exfiltration.
Compares 30 LLM-agent configurations systematically.

title: Evaluating the Instruction-Following Robustness of Large Language Models to Prompt Injection
title_zh: 评测大模型面对提示注入时的指令遵循鲁棒性
why_zh: 这篇论文直指核心矛盾：模型越会遵循指令，不代表越能判断哪条指令有权限被遵循。
why_en: It exposes the central tension: better instruction following does not imply better judgment about which instruction is authorized.
contributions_zh: 建立面向提示注入的指令鲁棒性基准。
分析模型错误遵循嵌入指令的行为模式。
揭示上下文理解能力与抗注入能力之间并非简单正相关。
contributions_en: Creates a benchmark for instruction robustness under prompt injection.
Analyzes patterns in which models follow embedded instructions incorrectly.
Shows that contextual understanding and injection resistance do not have a simple positive relationship.

title: The Attacker Moves Second: Stronger Adaptive Attacks Bypass Defenses Against LLM Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections
title_zh: 攻击者后出手：自适应攻击绕过越狱与提示注入防御
why_zh: 它提醒读者不要被静态攻击集上的低成功率迷惑：真正的攻击者会针对防御机制调整策略。
why_en: It warns against trusting low attack rates on static test sets: real attackers adapt to the defense being evaluated.
contributions_zh: 提出以防御为已知条件的自适应评测原则。
系统扩展梯度、强化学习、随机搜索和人工探索攻击。
对 12 种近期防御给出高成功率绕过结果，暴露静态评测缺陷。
contributions_en: Argues for defense-aware adaptive evaluation.
Scales gradient, reinforcement-learning, random-search, and human-guided attacks.
Bypasses 12 recent defenses at high success rates, exposing weaknesses in static evaluation.

title: Defending Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks With Spotlighting
title_zh: 用 Spotlighting 防御间接提示注入
why_zh: 它是低改造成本的输入来源标记思路，适合与后续训练型、系统型防御比较，但不能把论文中的静态结果当作绝对安全保证。
why_en: A low-cost provenance-marking idea that is useful to compare with training and system defenses, while not treating static results as a security proof.
contributions_zh: 提出用输入变换持续标记不可信数据来源。
给出多种 Spotlighting 具体实现方式。
同时测攻击成功率与正常 NLP 任务效用。
contributions_en: Uses input transformations to continuously mark untrusted provenance.
Presents multiple concrete spotlighting variants.
Measures both attack success and benign NLP utility.

title: StruQ: Defending Against Prompt Injection with Structured Queries
title_zh: StruQ：用结构化查询防御提示注入
why_zh: StruQ 把“指令”和“数据”从接口到训练过程明确分开，是理解结构化防御的代表工作。
why_en: StruQ separates instructions from data at both the interface and training levels, making it a representative structured defense.
contributions_zh: 提出双通道结构化查询接口。
设计安全前端，避免应用直接拼接指令和数据。
训练模型只遵循指令通道内容，并评估安全与效用。
contributions_en: Introduces a two-channel structured-query interface.
Adds a secure front end instead of raw prompt-data concatenation.
Trains models to follow only the instruction channel and evaluates security and utility.

title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
title_zh: 指令层级：训练大模型优先遵循高权限指令
why_zh: 它把 system、user、tool 等来源的优先级变成明确训练目标，是当前 Agent 权限语义的重要基础。
why_en: It turns the priority of system, user, and tool instructions into an explicit training objective, foundational for agent authority semantics.
contributions_zh: 明确提出按来源权限排序的指令层级。
构造冲突指令数据，训练模型忽略低权限覆盖。
验证对未见攻击类型也能提升鲁棒性，同时尽量保持通用能力。
contributions_en: Defines an instruction hierarchy ordered by source privilege.
Generates conflicting-instruction data that teaches models to ignore lower-privilege overrides.
Tests generalization to unseen attacks while monitoring general capability.

title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
title_zh: 从系统设计上击败提示注入（CaMeL）
why_zh: CaMeL 不依赖模型自己识别恶意文本，而是在系统层分离控制流和不可信数据，并限制敏感数据流向。
why_en: CaMeL does not ask the model to recognize malicious text; it separates control from untrusted data and constrains sensitive flows at the system layer.
contributions_zh: 用特权模型生成程序控制流，用隔离模型处理不可信数据。
引入能力机制追踪数据来源并限制外泄。
在 AgentDojo 上以可证明安全为条件评估任务完成度。
contributions_en: Uses a privileged model for control flow and a quarantined model for untrusted data.
Tracks provenance with capabilities to restrict exfiltration.
Evaluates task completion with provable security conditions on AgentDojo.

title: SecAlign: Defending Against Prompt Injection with Preference Optimization
title_zh: SecAlign：用偏好优化防御提示注入
why_zh: 它把安全回答与被注入后回答做成偏好对，让模型不仅学习正确输出，也主动降低错误指令的偏好。
why_en: It trains on preferred secure outputs and dispreferred injected outputs, teaching the model both what to do and what not to follow.
contributions_zh: 构造包含注入输入、安全回答和不安全回答的偏好数据。
用偏好优化直接拉开安全与不安全输出的概率。
评估多类未见攻击，并同时检查正常任务效用。
contributions_en: Builds preference data with injected inputs, secure outputs, and insecure outputs.
Uses preference optimization to separate secure and injected behavior.
Evaluates unseen attacks while monitoring benign utility.

title: PoisonedRAG: Knowledge Corruption Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
title_zh: PoisonedRAG：针对 RAG 的知识腐化攻击
why_zh: 它清楚展示 RAG 知识库本身就是安全边界：少量恶意文档可同时操纵检索与最终回答。
why_en: It shows that the RAG corpus is itself a security boundary: a few malicious documents can manipulate retrieval and final answers.
contributions_zh: 把 RAG 知识腐化写成可优化的攻击问题。
分别设计白盒和黑盒条件下的恶意文本生成方法。
在百万级语料设置中评估攻击，并测试多种现有防御。
contributions_en: Formulates RAG knowledge corruption as an optimization problem.
Designs malicious-document methods for white-box and black-box settings.
Evaluates attacks at million-document scale and tests existing defenses.

title: Machine Against the RAG: Jamming Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Blocker Documents
title_zh: Machine Against the RAG：用阻断文档让 RAG 拒绝服务
why_zh: 它研究的不是让 RAG 胡说，而是让系统看似合理地拒答；这种故障更隐蔽，也不容易靠事实核查发现。
why_en: Instead of forcing false answers, it makes RAG plausibly refuse to answer—a stealthier failure that fact-checking may miss.
contributions_zh: 提出针对 RAG 的 jamming 拒绝服务威胁。
设计无需知道嵌入模型和生成模型的黑盒优化。
比较指令注入、辅助模型生成和无辅助模型优化三类阻断文档。
contributions_en: Defines a jamming denial-of-service threat against RAG.
Develops black-box optimization without knowing the retriever or generator.
Compares instruction injection, oracle-LLM generation, and optimization-only blocker documents.

title: Glue Pizza and Eat Rocks: Exploiting Vulnerabilities in Retrieval-Augmented Generative Models
title_zh: 胶水披萨与吃石头：利用 RAG 模型的知识库漏洞
why_zh: 它用攻击者不知道用户问题、知识库内容和模型参数的现实黑盒设定，研究公开语料被投毒后的错误建议。
why_en: It studies public-corpus poisoning under a realistic black-box setting where the attacker lacks queries, corpus contents, and model parameters.
contributions_zh: 定义面向开放知识库的现实黑盒投毒威胁。
构造能被检索并影响生成的欺骗内容。
分析投毒对事实回答和系统行为的影响。
contributions_en: Defines a realistic black-box poisoning threat for open knowledge bases.
Constructs deceptive content that is retrieved and influences generation.
Analyzes the effect of poisoning on factual answers and system behavior.

title: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases
title_zh: AgentPoison：通过投毒记忆或知识库红队测试 LLM Agent
why_zh: 它把长期记忆和 RAG 知识库视为同类检索入口，说明无需改模型参数也能植入隐蔽后门。
why_en: It treats long-term memory and RAG stores as retrieval surfaces where stealthy backdoors can be planted without changing model weights.
contributions_zh: 提出针对通用 Agent 记忆与 RAG 的检索后门攻击。
通过约束优化让触发词落入独特嵌入区域。
在自动驾驶、知识问答和医疗 Agent 上测试迁移性与隐蔽性。
contributions_en: Introduces retrieval backdoors for generic agent memory and RAG.
Optimizes triggers into distinctive embedding regions.
Tests transferability and stealth across driving, QA, and healthcare agents.

title: Memory Injection Attacks on LLM Agents via Query-Only Interaction
title_zh: 仅通过查询交互向 LLM Agent 注入恶意记忆（MINJA）
why_zh: MINJA 的威胁模型更现实：攻击者没有数据库权限，只通过普通查询就诱导 Agent 自己写入恶意记忆。
why_en: MINJA uses a stronger real-world threat model: the attacker has no database access and induces the agent to write malicious memory through normal queries.
contributions_zh: 提出 query-only 记忆注入攻击。
用桥接步骤把攻击查询与未来受害查询关联起来。
用提示逐步缩短策略提高恶意记忆的隐蔽性和可检索性。
contributions_en: Introduces query-only memory injection.
Uses bridging steps to connect attacker queries to future victim queries.
Progressively removes explicit cues to improve stealth and later retrieval.

title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents
title_zh: 藏在记忆里：LLM Agent 的休眠式记忆投毒
why_zh: 它把评测扩展到跨会话：恶意内容先休眠在长期记忆里，之后再触发行为或工具动作。
why_en: It extends evaluation across sessions: malicious content sleeps in persistent memory and activates during later behavior or tool use.
contributions_zh: 定义跨会话休眠式记忆投毒威胁。
逐段测量写入、检索和行为触发的完整攻击链。
在多种有状态助手上比较模型与攻击目标差异。
contributions_en: Defines cross-session sleeper memory poisoning.
Measures the full chain from write to retrieval to behavioral activation.
Compares models and attack goals across stateful assistants.

title: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox
title_zh: 用语言模型模拟沙箱识别 Agent 风险（ToolEmu）
why_zh: ToolEmu 用模型模拟工具和环境，低成本寻找长尾高危失败，是学习 Agent 安全测试工程的好入口。
why_en: ToolEmu emulates tools and environments with an LM to search for rare high-impact failures at lower engineering cost.
contributions_zh: 提出用 LM 模拟工具执行结果的可扩展测试框架。
构建 36 个高风险工具包和 144 个测试用例。
用人工评估检查模拟器和自动风险判断的真实性。
contributions_en: Introduces scalable LM-based tool emulation.
Builds 36 high-stakes toolkits and 144 test cases.
Uses human evaluation to validate emulator and risk-evaluator realism.

title: ToolSword: Unveiling Safety Issues of Large Language Models in Tool Learning Across Three Stages
title_zh: ToolSword：揭示工具学习三个阶段的安全问题
why_zh: 它把工具使用安全按输入、执行和输出三阶段拆开，能看清风险不只发生在工具调用前。
why_en: It splits tool-use safety into input, execution, and output stages, showing that risk is not limited to pre-call filtering.
contributions_zh: 定义覆盖三阶段的六类工具安全场景。
评测恶意查询、越狱、误导、风险提示、恶意反馈和错误冲突。
在 11 个开源与闭源模型上系统比较。
contributions_en: Defines six tool-safety scenarios across three stages.
Covers malicious queries, jailbreaks, misdirection, risky cues, harmful feedback, and error conflicts.
Compares 11 open and closed models.

title: RedCode: Risky Code Execution and Generation Benchmark for Code Agents
title_zh: RedCode：代码 Agent 的危险代码执行与生成基准
why_zh: 对代码 Agent 来说，危险不止是生成恶意文本，而是真正在解释器或 shell 中执行；RedCode 专门测这条边界。
why_en: For code agents, the danger is actual interpreter or shell execution, not merely unsafe text; RedCode evaluates that boundary directly.
contributions_zh: 把危险代码执行和危险代码生成拆成两个子基准。
在隔离 Docker 环境中用真实执行结果判定风险。
建立跨系统、网络和程序逻辑等场景的风险分类。
contributions_en: Separates risky execution from risky code generation.
Scores real execution outcomes inside isolated Docker environments.
Builds a taxonomy spanning system, network, and program-logic risks.

title: R-Judge: Benchmarking Safety Risk Awareness for LLM Agents
title_zh: R-Judge：评测 LLM 对 Agent 行为风险的识别能力
why_zh: 它研究 Agent 执行轨迹已经产生后，模型能否读懂多轮记录并识别风险，适合作为运行时监控研究起点。
why_en: It tests whether a model can read multi-turn agent traces and recognize risk, a useful starting point for runtime monitoring.
contributions_zh: 构建 569 条多轮 Agent 交互记录。
覆盖 5 类应用、27 个场景和 10 种风险。
把行为风险识别与一般有害文本判断区分开。
contributions_en: Builds 569 multi-turn agent interaction records.
Covers 5 application classes, 27 scenarios, and 10 risk types.
Separates behavioral risk awareness from generic harmful-text detection.

title: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks
title_zh: AgentLAB：评测 LLM Agent 面对长时程攻击的安全性
why_zh: 它补上单轮测试的盲区，专门研究攻击如何在多轮交互、工具链和持久状态中逐步累积。
why_en: It targets the blind spot of single-turn tests by studying attacks that accumulate across turns, tool chains, and persistent state.
contributions_zh: 定义意图劫持、工具链、任务注入、目标漂移和记忆投毒五类长时程攻击。
覆盖 28 个 Agent 环境和 644 个安全测试用例。
验证单轮防御难以稳定抵挡多轮自适应攻击。
contributions_en: Defines five long-horizon attacks: intent hijacking, tool chaining, task injection, objective drifting, and memory poisoning.
Covers 28 agent environments and 644 security cases.
Shows that single-turn defenses do not reliably stop adaptive multi-turn attacks.

title: Watch Out for Your Agents! Investigating Backdoor Threats to LLM-Based Agents
title_zh: 小心你的 Agent：LLM Agent 后门威胁研究
why_zh: 它说明 Agent 后门可以只污染中间思考或工具选择，即使最终答案看起来正确，执行过程仍可能已经越权。
why_en: It shows that an agent backdoor can corrupt intermediate reasoning or tool choice even when the final answer looks correct.
contributions_zh: 区分 Query、Observation 和 Thought 三类 Agent 后门。
把攻击结果扩展到中间步骤与工具行为。
在 ReAct Agent 上分析隐蔽性、有效性和防御。
contributions_en: Separates Query, Observation, and Thought backdoors.
Extends backdoor outcomes to intermediate reasoning and tool behavior.
Studies effectiveness, stealth, and defenses on ReAct agents.

title: Prompt Infection: LLM-to-LLM Prompt Injection within Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: Prompt Infection：多 Agent 系统中的 LLM 到 LLM 提示注入
why_zh: 它把单 Agent 注入扩展成会在 Agent 之间复制传播的感染链，突出消息传递本身就是信任边界。
why_en: It turns single-agent injection into a self-replicating chain across agents, showing that message passing is itself a trust boundary.
contributions_zh: 提出 LLM-to-LLM 自复制提示感染攻击。
展示数据窃取、诈骗、错误信息和系统扰乱等跨 Agent 后果。
提出 LLM Tagging，并与现有防护组合测试。
contributions_en: Introduces self-replicating LLM-to-LLM prompt infection.
Demonstrates cross-agent data theft, scams, misinformation, and disruption.
Proposes LLM Tagging and evaluates it with existing safeguards.

title: Red-Teaming LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Communication Attacks
title_zh: 通过通信攻击红队测试 LLM 多 Agent 系统
why_zh: AiTM 不需要控制任何单个 Agent，只篡改 Agent 间消息就能影响整个协作流程，是研究通信完整性的代表工作。
why_en: AiTM compromises collaboration by modifying inter-agent messages without taking over an individual agent, making it central to communication integrity.
contributions_zh: 提出 Agent-in-the-Middle 通信攻击。
用带反思机制的攻击 Agent 生成符合上下文和角色格式的恶意消息。
跨多种框架、通信结构和应用评测系统级影响。
contributions_en: Introduces Agent-in-the-Middle communication attacks.
Uses a reflective adversarial agent to craft context- and role-compatible messages.
Evaluates system-wide effects across frameworks, topologies, and applications.

title: LLM Agents Can Autonomously Hack Websites
title_zh: LLM Agent 可以自主攻击网站
why_zh: 它从另一个方向刻画风险：不是 Agent 被攻击，而是 Agent 作为低成本攻击者。阅读时要特别注意实验网站、模型版本和工具权限的限制。
why_en: It studies the opposite risk: agents as low-cost attackers. Its claims must be read alongside limits of the test sites, model versions, and tool permissions.
contributions_zh: 构建具备浏览器与代码工具的自主网络攻击 Agent。
在沙箱网站上评估多类常见漏洞利用能力。
比较模型、工具与规划组件对成功率和成本的影响。
contributions_en: Builds an autonomous web-hacking agent with browser and code tools.
Evaluates exploitation across common vulnerability classes on sandboxed sites.
Compares how models, tools, and planning components affect success and cost.
